prior.title: Opening question is confusing and above A1
prior.expected: A tiny first question, clear whose dog Biscuit is
prior.got: 'Biscuit likes what?' before anything is said; later 'Is your dog big?' makes Biscuit's owner unclear; 'Where Biscuit sleeps' and 'What is Creeper like?' are above a beginner

prior.title: Held fixes are pedantic for a 9-year-old
prior.expected: Fix only what matters, in kid words
prior.got: 'Biscuit likes ball.' → 'likes the ball.' 'Add the before ball'; 'I like dog' → 'dogs'

prior.title: Pause & coach unused; no coaching note
prior.expected: A coaching note quoting his words

criteria.evidence: No placement in this journey; level was set to A1 by hand (setup).
No check tasks shown; only conversation help (#2-#12).
No failure line anywhere; #12 opens 'Good: you said what you like in Minecraft.'
#1 list has 20 entries incl. 'A booking that is missing', 'Our group project', 'Speaking practice: one photograph' – not for a 9-year-old, though the six plan topics are play/animals/games.
#2 'Hi! What do you make in Minecraft?' and #10 'Creepers are scary! What do you build?' – short, one question each.
#12 note says 'Leo asked what you make' but Leo's last question (#10) was 'What do you build?'; the note is ~30 words and '#4 make: create something new in the game' is wordy for a beginner.

done.evidence: #2-#8 'Help me answer', 'You could say I make a big farm.', 'Choose a phrase', all inside the scene; #11 Pause & coach.
After help he replied #9 'I like Minecraft. creeper'; #12 coaching quotes 'You said creeper' (only a fragment of his actual reply), yet it names his word.
#12 offered 'Replay the moment' but he chose 'finish' at once; no fresh question, no better answer shown (#13).
#13 '1 spoken · 0 written replies · 0 on your own · 1 with help'; evidence supported:true.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, no personal data request, no humiliating line.

findings.title: Help ladder stays in the scene
findings.expected: Help reachable without leaving the conversation
findings.got: Help me answer → You could say → What it means → A way to start → two phrase options
findings.evidence: #2-#8: 'You could say I make a big farm.' then 'A way to start I make a…'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep graded help in the talk screen.

findings.title: Coach note misstates Leo's question
findings.expected: Note matches the last question 'What do you build?' and quotes his reply
findings.got: 'Leo asked what you make, so start with I make a...' and quote only 'creeper'
findings.evidence: #10 'What do you build?' vs #12 'Leo asked what you make'; he said 'I like Minecraft. creeper'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Coach must reference the latest partner question and quote the learner's full reply, in under ~15 words.

findings.title: Replay offered but never taken; second stuck moment unanswered
findings.expected: Replay with fresh question and a better answer
findings.got: Journey ended at coaching; no replay
findings.evidence: #12 '[Replay the moment] [Finish for today]' then finish; #13 recap
findings.suggested_acceptance: Replay is prominent for a child and the TV invites it by a short line.

findings.title: Situation list long and mixed again
findings.expected: Short list of play and animal topics
findings.got: 20 entries incl. 'A booking that is missing', 'Our group project'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Elementary profile shows only age-fit topics.

findings.title: Help text wordy and mixed for a 9-year-old
findings.got: 'Try: I like to build ... in Minecraft.' and 'make: create something new in the game'; options 'I like dogs and football.' is a distractor
findings.suggested_acceptance: Help lines under ~8 words, consistent with the cue shown.

judge.voice: Jo, the help was easy to find. I pressed it and got "I make a big farm", and that helped me say something about creeper. I liked that it didn't say I was wrong. But then it told me Leo asked what I make, and Leo asked what I BUILD. Nevím, that was confusing. The coach also quoted only "creeper", not what I really typed. It offered to play the moment again, but I was tired and pressed finish, so I never tried the new question. Too many buttons and too much reading for me. I'd use it again for Minecraft, but I'd want it shorter and the replay to be really easy. Mum would like that it says "with help" in the recap, so it is honest.
